references.text: Describes the hanging half of the extra curtain that was to hang behind the tabernacle, which is the direct context for verse 13.
Parallel text describing the actual execution of the instructions given in Exodus 26:13 regarding the surplus parts of the curtains.
Basic instruction to build the tabernacle according to the pattern shown to Moses, which includes the completeness of the covering.
Describes how Moses spread the tent cloth over the tabernacle and placed the covering on top, showing the fulfillment of the instructions about covering.
The physical covering of the tabernacle in Exodus foreshadows God's eternal presence as a 'tent' over the saved in Revelation.
